summary: Starry Sea Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands blank-check company listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K after depositing $60,000 into its IPO trust account on November 3, 2026, extending its deadline to consummate an initial business combination by one month, from November 7 to December 7, 2026. The funds were loaned by SuperiorMed Healthcare, an affiliate of merger counterparty SuperiorMed, under the August 22, 2026 merger agreement, with a promissory note expected. The extension buys time for the two-step Cayman merger; watch note terms, redemptions, and closing risk.
